run_simulation_background: run the GrpcSimulationClient in a background thread with a specified time horizon using run_no_wait
stop_simulation_background: stop the background simulation thread by calling kill_run on the GrpcSimulationClient
execute_rpc_call: execute a gRPC call with round trip time logging via execute_rpc_call on GrpcSimulationClient
sync_mirror_simulator: sync the simulation client state to a real robot using the sync method on GrpcSimulationClient
set_robot_state: set the robot state in the simulation environment using set_robot_state on GrpcSimulationClient
